spec: §15 suite E (matching); §8.3 matching: the first gates entry in array order whose op, class pattern and inclusive controls range cover the gate and whose epsilon <= eps; else the first covering scheme; else load-time error; §8.1: "A target is a JSON document in RFC 8785 canonical form" (fixture bytes have no trailing LF)
derivation: In target.json the single cx entry (classes [fast], controls [1,1], epsilon 0) matches a cx executed on class-fast wires with total control count c = 1 (its own control, no effective context) at any eps, charging time 1. A cx executed under one inherited control has c = 2, which no entry or scheme covers: load-time error.
